home.title: What are you looking for?
home.scanHint: What it is and where it goes
home.reportHint: Broken or running low: scan its label, then Report
home.nothing: Nothing found. Try another word, or an order number.

common.qrForPhone: Scan with a phone to open this page there

errors.notFoundText: Nothing has the code {{code}}. It may be mistyped, or the label isn't assigned yet.

amount.tareHint: Optional: it comes off the reading, so only what's inside is kept
amount.onScale: How many on the scale ({{name}}, {{mass}} g each)
amount.tareTooMuch: The containers weigh more than the reading ({{amount}})
amount.sheetsHint: Each sheet's width x height, e.g. 1250x2500, 600x400

container.title: Comes in
container.hint: A spool, reel, box or bottle: its weight comes off when it's weighed with what's in it, and full ones can be added by number.
container.name: Container
container.names: spool, reel, box, bottle, bag, roll, tub
container.massHint: Optional: weighed empty, or from the maker

parts.title: Items
parts.emptyAll: No items yet. Add one, or let an AI assistant fill the Inbox from order emails.

part.confirmHint: This draft was added by an import or an AI assistant. Check it, then mark it as reviewed.
part.mergeHint: Merge this item into another one (its stock, units, order numbers, tags and files move over, then this one is deleted).
part.mergeTarget: Code of the item to keep
part.minStockIn: Optional, in {{unit}}: a container's unit if it has one
part.name: Name
part.initialStockHint: Where it is. Leave empty for the Inbox.
part.trackingBulkHint: How many and where: screws, suction cups, filament.
part.trackingIndividualHint: Each one has its own code, serial number, home place and log: tools, robots, PLC CPUs.
part.aliasesHint: Other names people use, separated by commas, e.g. impact driver, iskuporakone. Search finds these too.

places.title: Places
places.name: Name
places.moveHint: Move this place, with everything in it, under another place.
places.empty: No places yet. Start with the lab, then cabinets, shelves and boxes.
places.unassignedText: This code isn't used yet (maybe from a blank label). Register the place it's stuck on.
places.copyHint_one: Copies this place and the {{count}} place inside it, and all below, with new codes. Items and stock aren't copied.
places.copyHint_other: Copies this place and the {{count}} places inside it, and all below, with new codes. Items and stock aren't copied.
places.copyNameHint: Empty: numbered on from this one
places.copyMaps: Use the same maps, linked to the copies
places.codeHint: Code on the QR label; it never changes
places.shortNameHint: For the address, e.g. A or A140.1
places.hintHelp: Where it is inside the place it's in, for someone who just got there: landmarks and looks, not contents. E.g. "Grey two-door cabinet next to the project workbench".
places.numberFromHelp: So "Shelf 2" can be told as "the second shelf from the bottom".
places.addressRootHint: For a lab or room: the building and floor above stay out of its address, so adding them later changes nothing. The short name must be unique among these places. Changing this on a place with levels above it changes addresses, so reprint its labels.
places.clash: {{names}} has the same short name, so the address {{address}} isn't unique. Give one of them another short name.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.intro: New things land here: parts from order emails and AI drafts. Review them and put them away.

scan.title: Scan
scan.intro: Point the camera at a QR label, or type the code printed next to it.
scan.invalid: That doesn't look like a code.
scan.pickHint: Scan boxes, places and tools to pick them up. For items in stock, open the item and choose how many to carry.
scan.dropHint: Scan where you are putting things down.
scan.partNeedsLot: Opening the item: choose which stock and how many to carry.
scan.cameraInsecure: The camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open ixfwms over https://, or type the code instead.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera access was refused. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the code instead.
scan.cameraMissing: No camera found on this device.

login.title: Log in
login.name: Name
login.intro: Anyone on the lab network can look things up. Log in to add, move or change things.
login.noAccount: No account? An admin can create one on the Users page.

carry.title: Carrying
carry.intro: Things you picked up stay in the inventory as "carried by you" until you put them down, so nothing goes missing on the way.
carry.empty: You are not carrying anything. Scan a box or a tool with "Pick up", or use Carry on an item.

labels.title: Labels
labels.label: Label
labels.blankIntro: Print a batch of unused codes and stick them on boxes as you go. Scanning a blank label offers to register the box with that code.
labels.placeIntro: Download a CSV with the place and, optionally, everything inside it.
labels.ptouchSteps: Make one template per tape width in P-touch Editor (once): a QR code object linked to the qr column and text objects for code, name and path. Then File › Database › Connect, choose the downloaded CSV, and print all records. For a single label from a phone, use the PNG with the Brother app.
labels.laserIntro: DXF and SVG QR codes are vector shapes in millimetres, with extra error correction for scratched or dirty tags.
labels.batchesIntro: Each time blank labels are reserved, the codes are kept as a batch. Lost the printout? Download the unused codes again. Lost or damaged labels? Retire their codes so they are never used.
labels.retireHint: Retired codes are never handed out again. Scanning one says the label should be thrown away.

session.title: Add items
session.intro: Quick add, one kind of item at a time. Details can be completed later.
session.existing: Already in the inventory: pick one to add to it
session.notThis: Not this one: a new item
session.restAsNew_one: Add the other {{count}} as new stock (bought new, or from a pocket)
session.restAsNew_other: Add the other {{count}} as new stock (bought new, or from a pocket)
session.unitsShort_one: {{count}} more than there are free; register new units on the item's page first.
session.unitsShort_other: {{count}} more than there are free; register new units on the item's page first.
session.freeAndMore_one: {{count}} counted free, and more nobody counted
session.freeAndMore_other: {{count}} counted free, and more nobody counted

picker.placeholder: Type a place name or code…
picker.noMatch: No matching place. A known code works too.
picker.hint: Tab or → looks inside the highlighted place · Enter chooses
picker.hintInside: Enter chooses this place · Tab looks further in · Backspace goes back up

categories.title: Categories
categories.empty: No categories yet. They are created when items get one, or add the starter set.
categories.pick: Pick a category to see and edit the fields its items have.
categories.noFields: No fields of its own yet.
categories.label: Field
categories.starterNone: All starter categories already have fields.
categories.colourOptionsHint: Leave empty for the whole palette, or list palette names (e.g. black, red, blue)
categories.offerText: Adds common lab categories with useful fields: screws and nuts (thread, length, head), suction cups, ejectors, fittings, tubing, wire, terminal blocks, PLCs and filament (material, colour, diameter). You can change or delete them later. This is also in the ⋯ menu.
categories.itemsBelow: Items in this category and the ones below it
categories.renameOrMove: Name, with the categories above it
categories.renameHint: Fix a typo, or give another path to move it with everything below it, e.g. Pneumatics/Vacuum/Suction cups.
categories.deleteHasChildren: It has categories below it. Move or delete those first to delete this one.

import.title: Import from a spreadsheet
import.intro: Bring in an existing parts list or an order export (CSV or Excel). Rows become drafts in the Inbox (or the place you choose), and rows with a known order number add stock to that part instead.
import.defaultLocation: Put rows without a place in
import.matchExisting: Add stock to parts we already have (same order number or MPN) instead of creating duplicates
import.done: Review the new drafts in the Inbox
import.blankUncounted: has stock nobody has counted yet

bom.title: Can we build it?
bom.intro: Check a parts list against stock: paste rows from a spreadsheet, or load a parts list exported from Solid Edge, NX, Inventor, EPLAN or TIA Portal.
bom.pasteHint: Copy rows from Excel including the header row. Columns can be in any order.
bom.buildable_one: We can build {{count}} complete set from stock.
bom.buildable_other: We can build {{count}} complete sets from stock.
bom.buildableUnknown: Probably, but some parts are tracked only as a level or a length, so check those lines.
bom.tagLabel: Tag the matched parts with a project

maps.title: Where on the map
maps.howTo: Upload an SVG drawing (Inkscape, Illustrator) or a 3D model exported from Blender as .glb, then use “Link shapes” to click each shape and pick the place it stands for. Shapes or objects named loc- plus a code, e.g. {{example}}, link by themselves.
maps.removeConfirm: Remove this map from this place?
maps.unknown: Ids for places that aren't inside this one: {{codes}}
maps.model3dHint: Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom, click a highlighted object to open it.
maps.broken_one: {{count}} link lost its shape (the drawing changed):
maps.broken_other: {{count}} links lost their shapes (the drawing changed):
maps.pickShape: Click a shape in the drawing to link it to a place inside this one.
maps.replaceShared_one: This drawing is used by {{count}} place. Replace it?
maps.replaceShared_other: This drawing is used by {{count}} places. Replace it for all of them?
maps.brokenAfter_one: {{count}} link lost its shape; see the map's place to fix it.
maps.brokenAfter_other: {{count}} links lost their shapes; see the maps' places to fix them.
maps.copyOverwrites: This replaces the links made here. Continue?
maps.useExisting: Or use a drawing from the library
maps.replacesOwn: This place already has a map of that kind; use this one instead?
maps.model3dPickHint: Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom, click an object to select it.
maps.libraryIntro: Drawings and 3D models can be shared: draw a cabinet once and use it for every cabinet like it. Replacing a drawing updates every place that uses it, and links that lose their shape are listed here.
maps.libraryEmpty: No maps yet. Add one here, or on a place's page.
maps.brokenHint: Some links point at shapes that are no longer in the drawing. Open the place and link them again.

users.title: Users
users.intro: People who can log in, and accounts for scripts and AI assistants. Give an assistant an account with no password and a token with the inventory scope: it can add drafts and move things, but not confirm drafts.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Optional for token-only users.
users.tokenOnce: Copy this token now. It is not shown again.
users.offHint: Turning an account off stops logins and revokes its tokens. Everything the person did stays in the history under their name, and the account can be turned back on.
users.hasLoans_one: Responsible for {{count}} loan out of the lab: return it, or lend it again under someone else, first.
users.hasLoans_other: Responsible for {{count}} loans out of the lab: return them, or lend them again under someone else, first.
users.isCarrying_one: Carrying {{count}} thing: it needs to be put down first.
users.isCarrying_other: Carrying {{count}} things: they need to be put down first.
users.offSince: Turned off since {{date}}. No logins, no tokens; the history keeps the name.
users.removeHint: This account has no history (added by mistake, say), so it can be removed for good.
users.cantRemove_one: {{count}} entry in the history names this person, so the account can't simply be removed. Turn it off to keep the name, or erase the person.
users.cantRemove_other: {{count}} entries in the history name this person, so the account can't simply be removed. Turn it off to keep the name, or erase the person.
users.eraseHint: Erasing (for a GDPR request, say) deletes the account, its password and tokens. What the person did stays in the history as “Removed user”. Names typed into notes or loan descriptions are not changed, and older backups still have the name until they are rotated out.
users.settingsHint: They get these the next time they open the app.
users.tokensHint: Deleting one stops whatever uses it right away. People make their own on their account page.

account.homeHint: Searches start limited to this location, with everything inside it. You can always search elsewhere.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Snapshots of the database, taken every night and before every upgrade. Uploaded files live next to the database; back up the whole data folder too.

setup.title: Phone & AI setup
setup.secure: This connection is secure (HTTPS). The camera scanner can be used.
setup.insecure: This connection is not HTTPS, so phones will not allow the camera scanner. QR labels still open with the phone's own camera app.
setup.why: Browsers only allow the camera on secure connections. The lab server uses its own certificate, which each phone has to trust once.
setup.certTitle: Trust the lab certificate (once per device)
setup.noCert: No certificate is available here. Start the server with the https profile (see README).

ios.title: iPhone / iPad
ios.text: Download, then Settings › General › VPN & Device Management › install the profile. Then Settings › General › About › Certificate Trust Settings › turn on ixfwms.

android.title: Android
android.text: Download, then Settings › Security › Encryption & credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate, and pick the file.

mac.title: macOS
mac.text: Download, open it in Keychain Access, double-click the certificate, and under Trust choose “Always Trust”.

windows.title: Windows
windows.text: Download, double-click › Install Certificate › Local Machine › “Trusted Root Certification Authorities”.

setup.aiText: Ask an admin for an API token (Users page), then add the server to Claude Code:

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.footer: Shortcuts work when you are not typing in a field. Esc leaves a field.
shortcuts.take: Take from the first stock entry

labelFix.stickerHint: The label actually stuck on it (e.g. a blank one)
labelFix.freshHint: Then print a new label. The old code is retired either way.
labelFix.retiredText: This label was taken out of use on {{date}}. Throw it away, or scan the label next to it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.forgottenHint: Things picked up and not put down for this long are shown as probably forgotten in the Inbox.
settings.labelsIntro: Labels pages start with this tape width.
settings.mappingsIntro: Column mappings saved on the Import page, for spreadsheets that come in the same layout again (a supplier's order export, say).
settings.noMappings: No saved mappings yet. Save one on the Import page.
settings.serverIntro: These are set where the server runs (environment variables or .env), and need a restart to change. Shown here for reference.
settings.guestsIntro: Anyone on the lab network can look things up and report problems. Choose what else people without an account (students, visitors) may do. Everything they do is in the history, with the name they give.

guestLevels.workstation: … and bring things to a workstation

guestLevelHints.put_back: Tools back to their home places, stock back where it came from.
guestLevelHints.workstation: Also gather tools and parts at a workstation, and clear it again.

settings.guestsNever: Never without an account: lending, pallets, editing or deleting.
settings.guestsViewAlways: Either way, people's names, loan reasons, network details, prices, the history and the Inbox need a login. Contacts of temporary places always show: they are who to ask.

guestViews.limited: Items and places, without notes or serial numbers

guestViewHints.limited: Item and place descriptions show. Notes, log entries, problem report texts, serial numbers and firmware versions need a login.
guestViewHints.full: Notes, log entries, problem report texts, serial numbers and firmware versions show to anyone on the lab network.

settings.levelsIntro: The levels offered for stock tracked as a level, best first. Each one means OK, low (shows in the low-stock list) or empty. A level some stock is at can't be removed until that stock is set to another one.
settings.typesShortIntro: The types offered when adding a place. Changes save as you make them.
settings.legendMovable: Containers that get carried around (boxes, bins, pallets). They aren't part of addresses, so moving them never makes an address or label wrong. The others (rooms, cabinets, shelves) make up addresses like Robolab-A-C.
settings.legendWorkstation: Tables people bring tools and parts to. Anyone may bring things there (if allowed under Without an account), and Clear the bench sends them back.
settings.legendStay: A place nobody has touched for that many days (no stock in or out, not moved, nobody pressed Still needed) is flagged amber and listed in the Inbox. Empty for places that stay.
settings.legendBuild: Things made from parts (a gripper, a test rig). What's in them is built in, not free stock, and they can be dismantled to put the parts back.

temporary.expectedStayHint: Flagged if left untouched this long
temporary.overdue_one: Untouched for longer than its {{count}} day
temporary.overdue_other: Untouched for longer than its {{count}} days

reports.title: Problems
reports.thanks: Thanks, the report is in the Inbox.

bench.title: Clear the bench
bench.intro: Tools go back to their home places and stock back where it came from. Whatever nobody knows a place for stays here.

network.title: Network list
network.intro: Made from the IP addresses, host names and MAC addresses on units.
network.empty: No unit has network details yet. Add them on a unit page.

units.title: Units
units.homeHint: Where it belongs; Put back takes it here.
units.serialsLater: Serial numbers and names can be added on each unit afterwards.
units.guestNameHint: Optional, shown in the history. Remembered on this device.
units.workstationOnly: Without an account, things can only be brought to a workstation.
units.returnToHint: Leave empty for its home place.
units.lentOutSince: Lent out of the lab since {{date}}
units.lendWhatHint: E.g. "thesis tests at Company X, for Pekka V." Student names only here, as free text.
units.responsibleHint: Someone with an account, e.g. the supervising teacher. Empty = you.
units.loginForNetwork: Log in to see network details
units.networkHint: Network details are shown only to people who are logged in. Never store passwords here.
units.addWhichHint: One per line: name; serial number (either may be empty). Or just a number for that many.

loans.lendPlaceIntro: Everything in it goes along. Nothing can be taken out or put in until it's back.
loans.cameBackHint: Untick anything that didn't come back; it's marked lost.
loans.returnToHint: Leave empty to put it back where it was.

builds.dismantleIntro: Take it apart for parts: everything goes back where it came from, or onto a table to sort first. Once nothing is left in it, it's marked dismantled; its label keeps working and this page keeps the list of what was in it.
builds.putBack: Put everything back where it came from
builds.left: Still in it (no known place): {{names}}. Put these away by hand, then dismantle again.
builds.check_one: A build: checked on after {{count}} day untouched
builds.check_other: A build: checked on after {{count}} days untouched
builds.checkDue_one: Untouched for over {{count}} day: still in use?
builds.checkDue_other: Untouched for over {{count}} days: still in use?
builds.makeIntro: Moves the matched parts from free stock into a new build, so they're recorded as built in. What can't be moved that way is listed.
builds.name: Name
builds.title: Builds
builds.intro: Things made from parts: grippers, rigs, fixtures. What's in them is built in, not free stock, and comes back when they're dismantled.

cut.title: Cut stock
cut.titleHint: Profiles and tube by length, sheet metal and boards as sheets: each piece keeps its size, so offcuts stay pieces of their own.
cut.staysAsItIs: Empty: all of it. Nobody counted this, so it stays as it is.
cut.cutSheet: Or cut a piece, mm (width × height)
cut.cutHint: From the smallest piece it fits in
cut.badSize: That isn't a size: give millimetres, e.g. 400 or 300 x 200
cut.leftover: What to keep of the sheet

delete.partHint: The item goes completely: its stock, units, files and history. Not while it's in a build or one of its units is lent out (return it or mark it lost). To keep it on record, archive it.
delete.unitHint: The unit goes with its log. Not while it's in a build or lent out (return it or mark it lost). A unit that's gone for real is better archived.
delete.placeHint: For a place made by mistake. Only when it's empty and no unit has it as home.
delete.buildHint: For a build made by mistake. Only when it's empty; dismantle it first.
delete.dismantledHint: Delete the record of this build, with what was in it. Its parts' own history stays.

lost.foundHome: Found it: put it back at {{place}}

archive.partHint: Archive an item you don't use any more but want to keep on record: it's left out of search and lists (the Archived filter finds it), its code still scans, and Unarchive brings it back.
archive.partNote: Archived: left out of search and lists. Its stock, units and history are kept.
archive.placeHint: Archive an old container to put it out of sight: it's left out of place lists and pickers and nothing can go in it, but its code still scans. Only when it's empty and no unit has it as home.
archive.placeNote: Archived {{date}}: left out of place lists, and nothing can go in it. Its history is kept.

person.noMatch: No one by that name has an account.

finance.title: Depreciation list
finance.hint: For the finance people. Only members see these.
finance.meta: Tools and devices with purchase details.
